canonical_edition: F. Jacoby (ed.), Die Fragmente der griechischen Historiker 2B, no.184, pp.914–917 (fragmenta).
sources_tested: Canon row 1976.002; DFHG Müller–Jacoby concordance; Brill Jacoby Online historian index; Digital Athenaeus FGrH 184 record; local FHG III scan register; Internet Archive book/pagination checks; remote visual boundary/Greek checks
open_text_result: No complete reusable Greek transcription matching the whole FGrH 184 fragmenta section was found. Digital Athenaeus exposes a specific ancient host for F 6 but is an index/concordance, not a complete edition of FGrH 184. No provider OCR was used.
open_text_license: No reusable licence for a complete Greek FGrH 184 fragment transcription was verified.
scan_result: The earlier Müller FHG III scan maps the Metrodorus fragments precisely to p.204 right column (heading ‘TA PERI TIGRANON’, beginning fr.1) through p.205 (continuing numbered fragments through fr.14); p.206 begins the next author, Cornelius Alexander Polyhistor. Greek and the physical end boundary were visually checked remotely.
scan_rights: The 1849 edition is public domain, but the Archive item does not state a licence for the digitised images; this is insufficient for public HF redistribution. The local scan register records the same limitation.
next_action: For any acquisition, obtain a compatible-image-rights source or an explicit reuse determination first. Then remotely transfer only FHG III p.204 from the right-column ‘TA PERI TIGRANON’ heading and p.205 through fr.14 (not p.204’s left-column testimonia and not p.206); perform project-owned OCR and map FHG fragments to FGrH 184 individually.
notes: The FHG predecessor is strongly mapped at the image level but it is not asserted identical to Jacoby’s FGrH pp.914–917; it supplies a controlled fallback for the fragment witnesses, not a silent edition substitution.
